title: Feature-Fused Intrusion Detection: A Stacking Framework With Ensemble Classifiers, Deep Learning, and Autoencoder Anomaly Signals
description: Reproducible research software and supporting artifacts for a CIC-IDS2017-based hybrid intrusion detection study. The repository implements a stacking framework combining ensemble classifiers, deep learning, and autoencoder-based anomaly signals for intrusion and zero-day attack detection.
